cases.task_instruction: Return exactly one compact JSON object with these keys and no others: company, q1_rev, q3_rev, rev_delta, q3_margin, delivery_risk. Use revenue in USD millions, margin in percentage points, calculate q3_rev minus q1_rev, and summarize the primary delivery risk in a short string.

Return exactly one compact JSON object with these keys and no others: company, q1_rev, q3_rev, rev_delta, q2_margin, q3_margin, margin_delta_pp, q3_otd. Use revenue in USD millions, percentages as numeric values, rev_delta as Q3 minus Q1, and margin_delta_pp as Q3 minus Q2.

Return exactly one compact JSON object with these keys and no others: orion_q3_rev, nova_q3_rev, rev_gap, orion_q3_margin, nova_q3_margin, margin_gap_pp, orion_q3_otd, nova_q3_otd, otd_gap_pp, higher_churn. Define each gap as Orion minus Nova and name the company with the higher Q3 churn.
